title: Public snapshot is 14+ hours old and omits live Hotspawn CS2 fixtures that the lobby already lists
detail: Read 2026-10-23T04:58Z. https://buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/MaltaProj3/data/latest.json still serves generated_at 2026-10-22T14:05:35Z (run_status degraded, coverage_complete false, featured 37 upcoming / 30 picks / 7 unresolved; complete-picks 37/37 directional). Pages schedule runs 39807044948–39881298806 failed at 'Regression tests (repository fixtures, before any cache restore)' before collection. No probability was invented for the missing rows; they are listed with official Hotspawn and HLTV links on the executive summary live-coverage section. Lobby crowd participation was not used.

title: HLTV analytics pages for 23 Oct low-tier fixtures publish ranking/form, not two-sided prematch prices
detail: HLTV was read first for fixtures the featured method or the stale snapshot cannot price like a Polymarket/Thunderpick row. Phantom Academy vs Banda Chuya (2399699) analytics: Phantom Academy better ranked (#174) vs Unranked; K27 vs Virtus.pro (2399849) analytics: K27 #46 vs Virtus.pro #56 with stand-in Patsi. Neither page exposed a two-sided bookmaker decimal pair in the extracted record. HLTV fan votes and Hotspawn crowd participation were not used. bo3.gg NEXVOID vs Rare Atom (https://bo3.gg/matches/nexvoid-vs-rare-atom-23-10-2026) had lineups but no named coeff block. Polymarket Gamma lookups for cs2-nexvo-ra1-2026-10-23, cs2-k27-vp-2026-10-23 and cs2-bst-gal-2026-10-23 returned empty arrays. Model picks already in the snapshot are left as labelled research estimates.

title: JiJieHao vs Eternal Fire appears on the Hotspawn lobby without a View Match permalink
detail: At 2026-10-23T04:58Z the rendered lobby Closing Soon list included JiJieHao vs Eternal Fire (DraculaN Season 7) with crowd percentages, but no View Match URL in that card. HLTV independently lists the same pairing as match 2399638 (Digital Crusade DraculaN Season 7, bo3). The Hotspawn fixture id is left blank rather than guessed. No probability is published.
